headerDisplay: Fermax Blue / DuoxMe Video Doorbell Integration
footerDisplay: Door release and ring events in Apple Home. Home Assistant mode adds authenticated snapshots and video-only cloud preview. Hardware acceptance testing is required.

username.title: Fermax Username (Email)
username.description: The email address you use to log into the Fermax Blue or DuoxMe mobile app.

password.title: Fermax Password
password.description: Stored as plaintext in Homebridge configuration. Restrict config file access and use a dedicated invited Fermax account.

senderId.title: Firebase Sender ID (Optional / Experimental)
senderId.description: FCM messaging sender ID. Direct push also requires Firebase project ID, app ID and API key from your app configuration.

name.title: Accessory Name in HomeKit
name.description: The name that will appear in your Apple Home app for this doorbell.

deviceId.title: Device ID (Optional)
deviceId.description: Exact paired device ID. Required when the account has multiple monitors. An explicit mismatch fails setup.

deviceTag.title: Device Tag (Optional)
deviceTag.description: Alternative exact monitor tag; it must match one monitor. If both ID and tag are set they must identify the same monitor.

accessDoorKey.title: Door Key (Optional)
accessDoorKey.description: Exact access door key such as ZERO. Multiple doors require an explicit key or index; a mismatch fails setup.

doorIndex.title: Door Index (Optional)
doorIndex.description: Explicit numeric door selector, 0 for first entry. Out-of-range values fail setup. Prefer a stable accessDoorKey.

cameraStreamUrl.title: Camera Stream URL
cameraStreamUrl.description: Optional externally verified FFmpeg source. DUOX PLUS does not have a proven generic RTSP URL. In Home Assistant mode, leave blank to use its authenticated MJPEG camera endpoint.

cameraSnapshotUrl.title: Snapshot URL (Optional)
cameraSnapshotUrl.description: Optional HTTP JPEG override. Home Assistant mode uses the selected HA camera; direct mode uses Fermax photocaller if a registered app token is available.

cameraForceTranscode.title: Force Video Transcoding
cameraForceTranscode.description: Transcode to honor HomeKit resolution and bitrate. Home Assistant MJPEG always requires this. Disable only for an already compatible H.264 source.

cameraStreamOptions.title: Extra FFmpeg Options (Advanced)
cameraStreamOptions.description: Additional FFmpeg input arguments. For RTSP streams, try: -rtsp_transport tcp

cameraMaxBitrate.title: Maximum Video Bitrate (kbps)
cameraMaxBitrate.description: Limit video bitrate to reduce bandwidth usage. Default: 2000 kbps (2 Mbps).

unlockResetSeconds.title: Lock Reset Timeout (seconds)
unlockResetSeconds.description: Reset the displayed release state after this delay. This is a timer, not a physical door-position sensor; the plugin cannot remotely secure the door.

ffmpegPath.title: FFmpeg Binary Path (Advanced)
ffmpegPath.description: Override the auto-detected FFmpeg path. Only needed if FFmpeg is installed in a non-standard location.

cameraDebug.title: Enable Debug Logging
cameraDebug.description: Log generic FFmpeg diagnostic activity while withholding media URLs, bearer headers and SRTP keys.

clientId.title: Custom OAuth Client ID (Advanced)
clientId.description: Current OAuth client ID from your official DuoxMe app. The bundled legacy fallback has not been validated against current accounts.

clientSecret.title: Custom OAuth Client Secret (Advanced)
clientSecret.description: Current OAuth client secret from your official DuoxMe app. The bundled legacy fallback has not been validated against current accounts.

backend.title: Connection
backend.description: Use Home Assistant to reuse the maintained Fermax cloud media integration. Direct mode supports door release, experimental push, and an optional external video source.

firebaseProjectId.title: Firebase project ID
firebaseProjectId.description: Direct push client configuration from the official app; sender ID alone is insufficient.

firebaseAppId.title: Firebase app ID
firebaseAppId.description: Direct push client configuration from the official app; sender ID alone is insufficient.

firebaseApiKey.title: Firebase API key
firebaseApiKey.description: Direct push client configuration from the official app; sender ID alone is insufficient.

firebaseVapidKey.title: Firebase VAPID key (if needed)
firebaseVapidKey.description: Direct push client configuration from the official app; sender ID alone is insufficient.

homeAssistantUrl.title: Home Assistant URL
homeAssistantUrl.description: Server origin reachable from Homebridge, e.g. https://ha.example.com.

homeAssistantToken.title: Home Assistant access token
homeAssistantToken.description: Long-lived bearer token; stored in Homebridge config. Use a dedicated HA user and protect this file.

homeAssistantLockEntity.title: Door lock entity
homeAssistantLockEntity.description: Exact lock entity, e.g. lock.entrance. No automatic fallback.

homeAssistantRingEntity.title: Doorbell event entity
homeAssistantRingEntity.description: Use the actual event.* doorbell entity, not the connectivity binary sensor. Older binary_sensor ring entities also work.

homeAssistantCameraEntity.title: Camera entity
homeAssistantCameraEntity.description: Exact camera.* entity for snapshots and authenticated MJPEG video.

homeAssistantPreviewEntity.title: Camera preview button
homeAssistantPreviewEntity.description: Exact button.* preview entity to wake a receive-only cloud stream when Apple Home opens video.

fermaxBaseUrl.title: Fermax API origin
fermaxBaseUrl.description: Direct mode. Only reviewed current/legacy Fermax HTTPS service hosts are accepted.

fermaxAuthUrl.title: Fermax OAuth URL
fermaxAuthUrl.description: Direct mode. Only reviewed current/legacy Fermax HTTPS service hosts are accepted.

layout.title: Home Assistant
layout.description: Used only in Home Assistant mode. Enter the actual HA entity IDs.

layout.title: Direct Fermax account
layout.description: Used only in Direct Fermax mode.

layout.title: Video Streaming (Optional but Recommended)
layout.description: Home Assistant mode supplies video automatically through authenticated MJPEG; direct mode needs a real external stream source.

layout.title: Device Selection (Optional)
layout.description: Direct mode only. Multiple monitors require an exact device selector; multiple access doors require an explicit key or index. Mismatches fail setup.

layout.title: Direct push (experimental)
layout.description: Full Firebase configuration is required. Use a dedicated invited user to preserve phone notifications.

layout.title: Advanced Settings
layout.description: Fine-tune plugin behavior. Most users can skip these settings.
